kpis.label: Doses administered
kpis.description: Vaccine doses with a recorded given date in this period. Doses saved without a given date are excluded rather than guessed.

kpis.label: Patients vaccinated
kpis.description: Distinct patients who received at least one dated dose in this period.

kpis.label: Distinct vaccines
kpis.description: Number of different vaccines administered in this period.

meta.note: Doses are counted by their recorded given date only; entries saved without a given date (or with a placeholder date before 1901) are excluded. Bulk-entered doses are linked to the vaccine catalog via their bulk vaccine id, recovering records the previous report missed. IAP vs other is derived from the vaccination schedule template the dose was recorded against (system-provided IAP chart vs a clinic-customised template).
